definitions.gloss: ever-changing; protean; able to change freely at will
definitions.explanation: Appearing or disappearing, or changing form, freely and unpredictably. A four-character idiom used for a skilled performer, a style of play, or something like light or clouds that keeps changing.

examples.japanese: {変幻自在|へんげんじざい}な⟦{投球|とうきゅう}→投球：15510_toukyuu⟧。
⟦{雲|くも}→雲：02202_kumo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{変幻自在|へんげんじざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: The clouds change shape freely and endlessly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{変幻自在|へんげんじざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}い{分|わ}ける→使い分ける：07666_tsukaiwakeru⟧⟦{声優|せいゆう}→声優：12093_seiyuu⟧だ。
examples.english: She is a voice actor who can change her voice at will to suit each role.

notes:
A literary four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧), {変幻|へんげん} "transformation" + ⟦{自在|じざい}→自在：21493_jizai⟧ "at will". Usually praise for skill.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {変幻自在|へんげんじざい}な⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧: an unpredictable attack
- {変幻自在|へんげんじざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧: to move freely and unpredictably
- {変幻自在|へんげんじざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧: protean skill

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自由自在|じゆうじざい}→自由自在：21838_jiyuujizai⟧: as one pleases, freely; {変幻自在|へんげんじざい} adds constant change of form
